title: A new Sedna-like object
statement: Exhibit an inner Oort cloud object not in the MPC distant-object snapshot of 2026-10-18: ground-based optical astrometry spanning at least 300 days from at least two stations, fitted under full planetary perturbations, whose barycentric perihelion distance exceeds 50 AU and semi-major axis exceeds 150 AU, each by at least three standard deviations.
witness_format: JSON object: designation (string), orbit {q, e, i, node, peri, tp, epoch} (heliocentric ecliptic J2000, degrees, JD TDB), observations (list of MPC 80-column optical lines, ground-based only), optional sigma_arcsec (default 1.0)
